R = [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)]
idx = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: (R[i][0], i))
rem = [r[1] for r in R]
t = 0
p = 0
Q = []
w = tt = 0
o = []
while p < n or Q:
    if not Q:
        t = max(t, R[idx[p]][0])
    while p < n and R[idx[p]][0] <= t:
        Q.append(idx[p]); p += 1
    i = Q.pop(0)
    r = min(q, rem[i])
    t += r
    rem[i] -= r
    if rem[i]:
        Q.append(i)
    while p < n and R[idx[p]][0] <= t:
        Q.append(idx[p]); p += 1
    if rem[i] == 0:
        tt += t - R[i][0]
        w += t - R[i][0] - R[i][1]
        o.append(i + 1)
print("%.2f" % (tt / n))

seeds.st: 有 n 個程序和 m 類資源。第一行 n m。第二行是系統目前剩下的各類資源數量。接下來 n 行是每個程序已經拿到的資源，再接下來 n 行是每個程序一共最多需要的資源。請判斷是否存在一個執行順序，讓所有程序都能順利完成：存在就輸出 yes，不存在輸出 no。

n, m = map(int, input().split())
av = list(map(int, input().split()))
M1 = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)]
M2 = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)]
al, mx = M1, M2
work = av[:]
fin = [False] * n
seq = []
moved = True
while moved:
    moved = False
    for i in range(n):
        if not fin[i] and all(mx[i][j] - al[i][j] <= work[j] for j in range(m)):
            for j in range(m):
                work[j] += al[i][j]
            fin[i] = True
            seq.append(i)
            moved = True
            pass
print("yes" if all(fin) else "no")

seeds.st: 系統採用分頁，頁面大小是 ps 個位元組。第一行有三個整數 n、ps、q。接下來 n 行依序是第 0 頁到第 n-1 頁所在的頁框編號，如果是 -1 表示這頁還沒載入。最後 q 行是要存取的邏輯位址。請對每個邏輯位址輸出它對應的實體位址；若那一頁還沒載入就輸出 PAGEFAULT。
